description: The Enterprise crew grows more cohesive as encounters with artificial intelligence, Klingon culture, alien diplomacy and the Borg push Picard beyond routine exploration and toward threats far larger than Starfleet expected.

s02e01.description: Troi becomes mysteriously pregnant with a rapidly developing alien child as the Enterprise transports dangerous biological samples.

s02e02.description: An immensely powerful being traps the Enterprise in a void and studies the crew's reactions to death as though they were laboratory specimens.

s02e03.description: Data's Sherlock Holmes program becomes dangerous when the holodeck creates Moriarty with enough intelligence to understand and challenge the world beyond the simulation.

s02e04.description: A charming freighter captain brings two feuding families aboard the Enterprise, while Data tries to understand comedy from a professional performer.

s02e05.description: A deaf mediator loses the telepathic chorus through which he communicates and must find a new way to negotiate peace between generations of enemies.

s02e06.description: A dying cyberneticist transfers his mind into Data's body, intending to escape death even if Data's own identity must disappear.

s02e07.description: A rapidly aging away team leads Crusher to a research station where genetically engineered children carry a dangerous unintended defense mechanism.

s02e08.description: Riker serves temporarily aboard a Klingon ship and must adapt to its brutal command culture when his captain chooses confrontation with the Enterprise.

s02e09.description: Starfleet orders Data dismantled for research, forcing a legal hearing over whether an artificial officer is property or a person with the right to choose.

s02e10.description: Wesley falls for a young ruler traveling to her homeworld, unaware that she and her guardian possess a radically nonhuman nature.

s02e11.description: An ancient Iconian probe infects the Enterprise's computer systems while Picard races the Romulans to investigate a gateway technology that once spanned the galaxy.

s02e12.description: Riker, Data and Worf find an impossible Earth-style casino on a lifeless planet, populated by characters trapped in a dead astronaut's pulp-fiction fantasy.

s02e13.description: The Enterprise encounters a duplicate Picard from six hours in the future and must determine what catastrophe made him abandon his ship.

s02e14.description: Riker faces an unexpected reunion with his estranged father while Worf's friends attempt to recreate an important Klingon rite he has been missing.

s02e15.description: Data secretly answers a child's plea from a planet facing destruction, placing personal compassion against the Prime Directive.

s02e16.description: Q throws the Enterprise far beyond Federation space to prove humanity is unprepared for what lies ahead, introducing Picard to the Borg.

s02e17.description: Geordi is captured by apparently inept aliens while Picard's reluctance to reveal a medical history complicates a routine surgical procedure.

s02e18.description: The Enterprise rescues a deliberately primitive human colony and discovers its lost sibling society has solved survival through cloning.

s02e19.description: Lwaxana Troi arrives during an intense Betazoid mating phase and pursues Picard while the Enterprise hosts suspicious diplomatic visitors.

s02e20.description: Worf reunites with K'Ehleyr when the Enterprise must intercept Klingon sleepers who still believe the Federation is their enemy.

s02e21.description: A Starfleet war game pits Riker against Picard just as Ferengi interference turns the simulation into a real tactical crisis.

s02e22.description: Riker lies critically ill while a treatment forces his mind through memories of earlier missions in search of a neurological path to recovery.
